preparation_weather: Repeat 2016-2023 forcing backward in whole eight-year blocks, preserving leap alignment; preparation sensitivity only, not observed historical weather

annual.crop: Processing-tomato calendar represented by existing generic annual-row PFT; winter cover uses the same PFT and is a capability diagnostic

rice.crop: Single annual rice season using the existing rice PFT

assumptions: Dates, irrigation amounts, harvest fractions and planting carbon are explicit diagnostic settings, not fitted or observed field operations.
Annual N is 200 kg/ha, within the UC processing-tomato guide's 140-280 kg/ha range; other operational settings require pilot plausibility checks.
Rice N is 160 kg/ha and irrigation is an open-loop input schedule; realized flooding and drying determine interpretability.
Treatments start on 2016-01-01; the first winter cover is established in October 2016 and terminated in April 2017.
Every pair branches from the same full restart checkpoint after baseline preparation; the 8 and 16 year preparation cases are separate sensitivity scenarios.
No changes to SIPNET code, drainage parameters, or crop traits are made to force agreement or drying.
Planting supplies leaf, stem and root carbon. Positive stem and root pools are required by hasSufficientBiomass in SIPNET v2.2.0; leafon mobilization is not added to an explicit planting event.
